parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to 5 minutes ago.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End of time window (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description:
Optional. Filter to services that have a `RUNS_ON` edge to a
`Resource{type:'environment'}` with this value (e.g. `production`,
`staging`, `dev`). Omit to disable the environment filter.
